headline: Celtics look to bounce back against Bulls tonight at the Garden
morning_brew: It is a quiet Monday in the Hub after a weekend that felt like an eternity, but the C's are back at TD Garden tonight for a conference clash with the Chicago Bulls. We are sitting at one and one on the young season, and frankly, I am looking for a statement performance to settle the nerves before I start pacing holes in my living room rug. We have seen some flashes, but now is the time to really lock in and defend home court against a team we should be treating like a speed bump if we have championship aspirations.

Payton Pritchard has been getting a lot of ink lately for his iso game, and honestly, seeing that kind of grit in the summer practices is exactly what I want to hear about. It is that kind of dog-in-the-fight mentality that made us love this team during the Banner 18 run. If he can keep that energy going off the bench tonight, I think we have a real chance to put some distance between ourselves and the middle of the pack early on instead of waiting for the schedule to get harder.

I am knocking on wood because the last thing I need is a cardiac event this early in the schedule, but I am feeling optimistic about tonight. My neighbor Rick is already whispering about the officiating crew assigned for this one, and he is convinced they have a dossier on us that goes back to the Coolidge administration, but I am just hoping for a clean game where the shots fall. First tip is at seven-thirty, and I will be parked in my spot, feet up, ready to see if we can start building some real momentum.

news_digest.headline: How Payton Pritchard became Boston's unlikely iso king
news_digest.dans_take: The man is playing with a chip on his shoulder the size of the Zakim Bridge.
